title: MultiSoc-4D: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Instruction-Induced Label Collapse in Closed-Set LLM Annotation of Bengali Social Media
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical phenomenon called 'label collapse' in LLM annotations for Bengali social media. While it includes dimensions such as hate speech and sarcasm and contains a section on 'Ethical Considerations', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
